scope: all 33 active scientific repositories: current default-branch identity/status plus typed programme relations and evidence-mode partition
display_rule: one active scientific repository = one visible fragment; repository existence alone is insufficient; typed connections never transfer evidence ownership

tracking.movement: Live public GitHub repository metadata marks repository motion, not automatic scientific revision.
tracking.scientific_ref_detail: Default branch main is authoritative for the active inventory. BALANCE PR #2 is merged; V3 and PAYOFF are substantive main-branch scientific repositories.

status_semantics.result: current scientific core closed; negative, mixed and conditional results count
status_semantics.bounded: repository-owned result exists with explicit empirical/transfer/external limits
status_semantics.open: a prospectively frozen or explicitly staged scientific gate remains unresolved
status_semantics.staging: repository exists but does not yet own an independent scientific question/inferential contract

philosophy.sentence: Not ownership of answers, but responsibility for what is retained, constrained, safely forgotten, returned to observation, and left revisable.
